text: The Tuppu mark: a clay tablet with wedge rows replaces the bolt, everywhere the old mark is used

Fixed in f072f3e: variant A from the Tuppu Mark canvas. favicon.svg, ic_brand_logo.xml, ic_launcher_foreground.xml (1.15x inside the adaptive circle) and the new alpha-only ic_notification.xml for the status bar; the poster's setSmallIcon switched to it; login image is 72x72. The old bolt path is gone from web/public and android/app/src/main; the committed server web_dist copy follows at the next release, as every web change does. Gate green.
